title: Builder saves keep stored cue, move and section times (B-3, B-2, B-1)
acceptance: The Codex repros repro/b-anchor-precision.repro.test.tsx and repro/b-builder-lost-update.repro.test.tsx are ported as regression tests and pass.
A text-only save keeps 10313, 12750 and 241500 ms; a free-placement drag to 65000 ms stays 65000 ms after a notes save.
A deliberate clock edit still snaps.

evidence.summary: Audit packet 1 records three P1 findings. Migration did not rerun reproductions.
Owner set Ready in session on 2026-10-28 and approved packet 1 scope as written (time fields sent only when edited; notes save stops sending startOffsetMs; inspector re-seeds).

Both Codex repros ran unmodified on main dc8e72a and failed 5/5 (9844, 13000, 242000, 60000, 10000). The ported tests (this file plus CuesSection, MovesSection and SegmentBand tests) were committed red first (906885c) and pass after the fix; deliberate cue and move clock edits still snap (0:11 to 10781 at 128 BPM).

Fix PR: cue, move and section edits omit the time unless the field was edited; the track inspector re-seeds an untouched Start at and sends startOffsetMs only when edited; cue and move lists reload when the run payload changes. Not deployed. Final review at 4a173d2 found two correctness bugs: a non-canonical or server-clamped typed start brought B-1 back, and a reverted clock was dropped when an edit row stayed open across a save. Both are fixed with fail-first tests, and syncKey now also reloads when the payload first arrives.

resolution: Builder saves keep stored cue, move and section times: B-1, B-2 and B-3 are fixed in the web client, with the Codex repros ported as regression tests. The stale classes.ts patch comment is corrected. No API, schema or migration change. The clip-start/downbeat stale-seed shape is routed to RF-119. The final review's non-significant findings are routed to RF-120.
